author: Church Machine
description: Wukong board hardware ROM boot program — LED blink and UART callhome beacon. Transcribed from WUKONG_NUC_PROGRAM in hardware/boot_rom.py. INFINITE LOOP: no RETURN, no CALL. Runs safely on an unconfigured FPGA without IDE involvement.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Load LED0 and UART_TX capabilities; set DR1=1.

methods.name: loop_top
methods.description: LED-blink + UART banner infinite loop (no RETURN).
